subject: Pilot extension & conditional discount options
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novum.ai>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Novum Procurement <procurement@novum.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 2-week pilot extension + pricing clarity

Lukas — thanks for the call yesterday. We’ve been moving internal stakeholders and need a short runway to validate a new ingestion pipeline that came up during integration. Two asks: 1) Can Novum extend our 30-day pilot by 14 calendar days? 2) Can you confirm whether there’s room for a one-time concession on the trial rate (we were hoping for ~15% off list for the extended days) while we finish the integration?

We want to avoid a bigger contract conversation until we see a constrained production run next quarter. If there’s a paperwork or LOI you need signed first, let us know — procurement will prioritize for an LOI but needs numbers to approve.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morris
Head of ML Ops, Novum.ai
[Attachment: integration_logs.zip (referenced)]
From: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novum.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week pilot extension + pricing clarity

Elena — appreciate the quick note and the context. We can definitely help. Two practical options to consider (summary here; I’ll attach a short spreadsheet with the math):

Option A — Time extension (14 days) at current pilot rate, no credits. We’ll extend capacity and keep the trial token rate as-is. Requires a signed extension addendum (no pricing change).

Option B — Time extension + conditional one-time concession. We can offer a 10% concession applied to the incremental usage for the 14-day extension, contingent on: (i) an LOI confirming anticipated production evaluation within 90 days, or (ii) a commitment to a sales-qualified follow-up demo date. If Novum signs an LOI, we’ll issue the concession via pro forma credit on the subsequent invoice.

I’m looping in Kim (pricing/legal) and Priyom (deal desk) to confirm we can finalize paperwork quickly. If procurement needs a simpler paper path, we can put a short LOI in DocuSign and route it to your procurement address.

I attached the rate spreadsheet with examples and a draft SOW that would accompany an addendum. Let me know which option you prefer and I’ll send the addendum + DocuSign link.

Cheers,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_ratecard_v3.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)]
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week pilot extension + pricing clarity

Lukas — quick internal: pricing is OK with Option B (10% concession on incremental extension usage) provided Novum signs an LOI that (a) states expected production evaluation within 90 days and (b) grants limited data-retention SLA alignment we already support. Finance wants the concession applied as a credit line item rather than changing base rates. Priyom — can you draft the addendum language and LOI bullet list? Marissa — FYI for post-signing onboarding touchpoints.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novum.ai>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Novum Procurement <procurement@novum.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week pilot extension + pricing clarity

Thanks, Lukas and Kim — that structure sounds workable. Two quick clarifications before procurement green-lights: 1) Can you show the numeric example (we need to show Finance the expected delta in spend for the extension)? 2) For the LOI, can the wording be a simple 1-paragraph statement of intent (no financial commitment) plus the expected evaluation milestone date?

If you can send the numbers and the LOI text today we’ll push it through our procurement queue.

Best,
Elena
P.S. We prefer DocuSign for quick signatures.
From: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novum.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week pilot extension + pricing clarity

Elena — attaching the short example and the LOI text. We kept the LOI non-binding (intent only). Summary: incremental cost for the 14-day extension at your current burn (projected 120k tokens/day) = $8,400 list; with the 10% concession on incremental usage, net incremental = $7,560. If you prefer Option A we’ll send the addendum with no pricing changes; Option B requires your LOI signed in DocuSign to trigger the concession credit on the first invoice after extension.

LOI (one paragraph):
"""
Novum.ai intends to extend its current time-boxed evaluation of Redwood Inference for an additional 14 calendar days in order to complete integration and production validation. Novum.ai expects to complete a production evaluation within 90 days of the extension start date and will coordinate a follow-up technical review with Redwood. This Letter of Intent is non-binding and is intended solely to document mutual expectations that facilitate operational continuity for the evaluation.
"""

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/loi/abcdef123456
Attachments: novum_sow_draft.pdf (draft SOW for the extension), redwood_ratecard_v3.xlsx (calculation sheet). I’ll initiate the DocuSign envelope once you confirm Option B.

Looking forward — I’ll stand by for the signed LOI and will expedite the addendum.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: novum_sow_draft.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]
